name: calluwu
description: Open source SDK, browser client, contracts, and realtime runtime for Calluwu voice agents

scripts.build:workspace-packages: pnpm --filter @calluwu/types build && pnpm --filter @calluwu/sdk build && pnpm --filter @calluwu/webrtc-client build
scripts.check: pnpm run licenses && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.format: biome check --write packages examples scripts && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: biome check packages examples scripts && cargo fmt --all --check
scripts.lint: biome lint packages examples scripts && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.test:ts: pnpm build:workspace-packages && pnpm -r test && node --test scripts/export-public.test.mjs scripts/publish-public-packages.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-version.test.mjs scripts/verify-node-licenses.test.mjs scripts/verify-rust-licenses.test.mjs
